messages.subject: shiny & javascript pivot table?
parts:
I would like to be able to add to my shiny set of tools a pivot table, say on the line of the one offered here https://github.com/nicolaskruchten/pivottable

For me a pivot table is a widget that allows to drag and drop  a series of dimensions and facts on a self-organising table (as in an Excel Pivot Table).

How would I do suc an integration into shiny?

Anybody has tried anything similar?

As apparently there are quite a few "free" libraries, are there other considerations beside the esthetical ones that determine an easy integration into shiny?

Thanks for the help!  Enzo
